title: Crying Sun Bird Tree
description: A surreal painting shows a large yellow bird with red hands and long multicolored tears crying on a dark gnarled tree branch. Below, ghost-like figures with melting faces hang from nooses dripping colorful liquid over a green landscape with pink houses and a river, while a bright sun shines above blue clouds containing floating skulls and a white ghost.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a giant yellow bird with red fists and long flowing multicolored tears crying loudly on a dark twisted tree branch. From the branches hang multiple white ghost figures with melting faces and colorful dripping liquid nooses. Below is a green hilly landscape with pink houses emitting pink smoke, a winding blue river, and black ground. Above are blue clouds filled with purple skulls and a white ghost, with a bright yellow sun radiating pink rays in a pink and blue sky, all enclosed in a red circular border decorated with repeating yellow fists, black skulls and other symbols.
